title: Art. 2.8.1 — American Convention on Human Rights, Part I, Chapter II, Article 8, Paragraph 1
content: Every person has the right to a hearing, with due guarantees and within a reasonable time, by a competent, independent, and impartial tribunal, previously established by law, in the substantiation of any accusation of a criminal nature made against him or for the determination of his rights and obligations of a civil, labor, fiscal, or any other nature.
